item.title: Attorney General Ellison asks court to protect children and consumers in Character.AI bankruptcy
item.description:
Publication Date: October 15, 2026

Joins broad, bipartisan coalition of 40 AGs in highlighting serious concerns about company’s safety and privacy practices, calling for protections for children and consumers in any sale of business or assets

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/10/15_CharacterAI.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison urges swift passage of latest Epstein Files Transparency Act
item.description:
Publication Date: October 16, 2026

Joins 17 AGs in urging Congress quickly pass Epstein Files Transparency Act II, which would give state AGs and survivors the power to enforce the transparency that Congress has already demanded but Trump Administration has ignored

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/10/16_EFTA.asp
